description: Source code for MtpFfsCompatHandle class implementing USB Mass Storage Protocol handling, including file transfer operations, endpoint management, and device property configurations within the Android platform.

classes.name: android::MtpFfsCompatHandle
classes.description: Class managing USB FFS (FunctionFS) handle for MTP (Media Transfer Protocol) operations, including file read/write, endpoint initialization, and property configuration.

methods.name: writeHandle
methods.description: Writes data to a file descriptor in chunks, handling partial writes and errors.

methods.name: readHandle
methods.description: Reads data from a file descriptor in chunks, handling partial reads and errors.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes endpoints, allocates memory, and configures device-specific read/write sizes for MTP transfer.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the bulk out endpoint.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the bulk in endpoint.

methods.name: receiveFile
methods.description: Receives a file over USB, handling large files and zero-length packets.

methods.name: sendFile
methods.description: Sends a file over USB, handling headers, chunking, and final packet.
